posts.text:
When historic flooding devastated St. Louis in the summer of 2022, I worked tirelessly to ensure that our community got the disaster relief it so desperately needed.

Over a year later, our community is still struggling to recover from the May 2025 Tornado.

St. Louis deserves a Representative with the expertise to fight to secure recovery funding.

When I’m back in Congress, I’ll do exactly that so our neighborhoods can rebuild.
